title: conyza pycnostachya
intro: Conyza pycnostachya, commonly known as Kanjikilai, is a plant species that belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae). It is a shrub that is native to tropical Africa and is widely used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, inflammation, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Conyza pycnostachya include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Conyza pycnostachya include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
